image.description: Generate or edit images via the capability dispatcher. Use `hub_generate_image` with `vendor` (banana/seedream/gpt-image/midjourney/kling) and `model_id` from the registry. Default vendor: banana. Reuse style_descriptors / character_refs from prior Output Summary. Pass sourceNodeId when editing canvas. Returns image paths.

video.description: Generate video via the capability dispatcher. Use `hub_generate_video` with `vendor` (MiniMax/veo3/seedance/jimeng/kling) and `mode`. Default vendor: MiniMax.
